svg.title: Mongoose (embedded web server) — Mongoose (embedded web server)
svg.desc: The sourced Mongoose (embedded web server) brand mark, preserving its original vector silhouette and using the supplied primary brand colour. No extra outline is added. mongoose.ws is the embedded web server, distinct from the MongoDB ODM.
